annotations.title: Heuristic wallet risk indicators, balances and account nonce on Base

description: Returns a heuristic high/medium/low address risk tier, named flags, ETH balance, holdings of 4 major tokens (USDC, WETH, cbBTC, DAI), and the Base EVM account nonce. Per-token risk is unknown because token contracts are not audited here. For EOAs the nonce counts outgoing transactions only, not full history. Address type is reported separately and does not affect the balance/nonce-based risk tier. Use to screen an address before paying it. Example: address=0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045. Price $0.02/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: wallet_audit
